appraisal_events.evidence: Odette, smiling, tells Swann his careful attentions do not bother her at all; though flustered, he persists with the flower pretext -- touching, brushing off pollen, smelling the blossoms -- and she ends by shrugging, as if to say 'you're mad, you can see it pleases me.'
appraisal_events.explanation: The passage culminates in Odette's plain, smiling, mutual receptivity to Swann's advances under the flower pretext; the dominant local outcome is his achieved intimacy, even though the mode of attainment is hesitant and pretext-laden.

status_effects.explanation: Swann attains the desired intimacy: Odette's smiling, explicit signal of pleasure at his advances marks the successful culmination of the flower pretext.
